description.text: Select this to render on the Local GPU, if available. You can select this even if no GPU is currently available on your machine. The GPU will then be used whenever the script is opened on a machine which does have a GPU available. You should also select this if you wish to render from the command line with the --gpu option. If this node requires full frames from its inputs, and is therefore unable to reduce its memory overhead, it will fall back to the CPU if an attempt to render a frame on the GPU fails due to lack of memory. When this occurs, a warning message will be printed to the console.

The overlap between images for the source footage is defined by the metadata from an upstream C_CameraSolver node.Keying: Set analysis keys where there is a change in exposure. The input footage is matched at the analysis keys to calculate the colour change between each camera. Analysis: Set the analysis options for the solve. Calculate a single gain correction for each camera, or correct the gain for each colour channel. Output: The colour correction is shown as a preview in the main view and the input views are updated. Adjust the exposure correction manually and update the global exposure. Export: Export the calculated grade.
description.text:
C_ColourMatcher 2.1v5: Analyse the overlap region between cameras to match the camera exposure.

Input: Set the projection type for the input views. The overlap between images for the source footage is defined by the metadata from an upstream C_CameraSolver node.

Keying: Set analysis keys where there is a change in exposure. The input footage is matched at the analysis keys to calculate the colour change between each camera.

Analysis: Set the analysis options for the solve. Calculate a single gain correction for each camera, or correct the gain for each colour channel.

Output: The colour correction is shown as a preview in the main view and the input views are updated. Adjust the exposure correction manually and update the global exposure.

Export: Export the calculated grade.
